Compute Pairwise Distance Matrix with Optional Eligibility Filtering

Source: R/distance.R
calc_distance_matrix.Rd

Calculates pairwise spatial Euclidean or ellipsoidal distances between canonicalized source and sink geometries. If geometries are polygons, centroids are computed automatically.

Usage

calc_distance_matrix(source, sink, max_distance = Inf, eligibility = NULL)

Arguments

source

An sf object of source geometries with required column id.

sink

An sf object of sink geometries with required column id.

max_distance

Numeric. Global maximum threshold cutoff distance (in CRS units). Distances greater than this threshold are set to Inf. Defaults to Inf.

eligibility

Optional eligibility specification to partition and restrict how source locations map to sink targets. Accepts an imumap_eligibility_rule, an imumap_eligibility_rules rule set, a list of rules, a custom predicate function f(source, sink), or a pre-computed logical matrix.

Value

An S3 object of class imumap_dist_matrix containing the pairwise distance matrix, source IDs, and sink IDs.

Examples

pts <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_point(c(0, 0)), sf::st_point(c(1, 1)), crs = 3857)
src <- sf::st_sf(id = c("s1", "s2"), school_type = c("pub", "priv"), geometry = pts)
snk_pts <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_point(c(0, 0.5)), sf::st_point(c(1, 1.5)), crs = 3857)
snk <- sf::st_sf(id = c("c1", "c2"), geometry = snk_pts)
# Rule-based eligibility: limit public schools to 500m
r_pub <- eligibility_rule(source_filter = list(school_type = "pub"), max_distance = 500)
dmat <- calc_distance_matrix(src, snk, eligibility = r_pub)
